status: PROPOSED catalogue (2026-10-21 UTC; revised for H1). Licenses are a $0 desk check of PRIMARY sources (HF dataset card + API metadata, the repository LICENSE file, PyPI, the paper); nothing was downloaded. _kind: isolation_check R0 refuses an item whose source is unregistered, not trainable, or lacks the fields its kind requires: a check that cannot run on an item does not pass it
_arc_lineage: isolation_check R7 refuses every item of a source whose arc_lineage is not 'none' (re_arc: ARC-AGI-1 training-task generators, a separate maintainer decision)
_approved_for_h1: set to true only by a recorded maintainer decision; source_plan.py refuses a generation plan naming a source that is not approved (2026-10-22: none is approved yet -- the H1 source scheme is decision 4)
